A [[human]] '''barfly'''<ref name="Very Interesting AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> frequented a [[bar]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]].<ref name="Very Interesting" /> Some time c. [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the individual was involved in a brawl with their fellow patrons. Once punched in the face by an [[Unidentified Aqualish barfly|Aqualish barfly]], the human barfly fell to the ground, only to stand up again and help a [[Unidentified barfly (Borgo Prime)|third barfly]]—who was held in the enemy's arms after sticking up for them—struggle free. The three individuals continued their rough-and-tumble after former [[pirate]] [[captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] passed by in the company of the four [[Skeleton Crew]] [[youngling]]s, who were all headed for the [[starship]] ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' so as to complete their escape from Jod's former [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]].<ref name="Very Interesting" />
